rule: Mobile CORE requires explicit mobile visual evidence, hierarchy preservation and purposeful mobile composition. Responsive existence alone is insufficient.

evidence: Studio Design Award nominee page explicitly states mobile-first layout because mobile users are the majority.
The official renewal press release publishes a smartphone TOP-page image alongside the PC TOP-page image.
The mobile-first design supports the same emotional-barrier goal: bright color, curves, readable article discovery and low-friction exploration.

mobile_review.notes: Treat as the first candidate for CORE promotion once the central registry is updated.
